subject: Mathematics

source.topic: This is what I wear: Numeracy

show.line: This is five. Five fingers in one glove. One, two, three, four, five!

rounds.prompt: Count the buttons on the shirt. How many?
How many socks on the washing line?
Count with me. One, two, three, four. What comes next?
rounds.praise: Five! One, two, three, four, five.

rounds.prompt: Draw five with your finger. Down, round the tummy, then a hat on top.

hints: Five comes after four. Hold up your hand. Five fingers!
Touch each one as you count. Stop at the last one.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count the buttons.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: One, two, three, four. Four buttons!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I missed one. There are five buttons.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. One, two, three, four, five!

parent_line: Can recognise, count and trace the number 5.
